items.name: Sarah M.
items.text: Within two months email went from an afterthought to our second-biggest sales channel. The flows they set up just quietly run.

items.name: James K.
items.text: We'd been meaning to fix our email for two years. They had our first welcome sequence live in under a week. Should have done this sooner.

items.name: Priya L.
items.text: Finally someone who talks about revenue, not open rates. Our monthly reporting is actually useful now.

items.name: Tom R.
items.text: The deliverability audit alone paid for the first month. We were landing in spam on half our sends and had no idea.

items.name: Emma W.
items.text: Responsive, sharp, and they actually understand what moves the needle for a subscription business. Felt like we were their only client.
